h1Parts: , where every front desk is busy.
lead: Lucoze puts patient records, appointments, GST billing, lab and pharmacy on one platform, with search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile and every byte of data hosted in India. We're built in Konnagar, West Bengal, so Tripura runs on remote-first onboarding, not a promise to drive to Agartala.
intro: Tripura's front desks look a lot like Bengal's — staff take names, notes and payments in Bengali, and Agartala is where patients from Udaipur, Belonia and the north travel to for the bigger diagnostics and specialists. Most clinic software here was written for an English-first, metro-first clinic and then bent to fit. Lucoze starts from the counter: a busy receptionist, a cash-and-UPI drawer, and paperwork for Ayushman Bharat and state schemes. The screens are in English with short plain labels, and onboarding trains your desk on your own patients. Records, billing, lab and pharmacy live in one place, and you can be live in about 14 days on ordinary broadband.
points: A simple search at the counter

Find a patient by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile. The screens are in English with short plain labels, and onboarding trains your front desk on your own patients, so staff aren't lost in the first week.

Our team is in Hooghly, West Bengal — a long way from Agartala. So Tripura clinics get video onboarding, hands-on data-migration help, WhatsApp and in-app chat, not a claim that we'll visit every chamber. On-site setup is on the table for larger hospital and nursing-home deployments.
Your patients' data stays in India

Every record sits in Indian data centres, DPDP 2023 compliant, with full CSV/PDF export and no lock-in. Cloud-based, so it runs on the broadband or mobile data you already have — nothing to install on each machine.
ABHA number, GST and schemes on one platform

Record the ABHA number at the first visit, raise GST-compliant invoices, and keep clean records for Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) and state schemes — instead of stitching together three separate tools and a register.
localContext: We're set up for clinics, nursing homes and diagnostic centres across Tripura — the referral hub of Agartala (Krishnanagar, Melarmath, and the hospital belt around Ronaldsay Road) and the district towns of Udaipur, Dharmanagar, Kailashahar, Belonia and Ambassa. The common thread is a Bengali-speaking front desk, with Kokborok and English in the mix, handling patients who often travel in from across the state. Because Agartala is far from our base in West Bengal, we lean on video onboarding and migration help rather than pretending distance isn't real — and East-India clinics are prioritised in our design-partner programme.

faqs.q: Can a Bengali-speaking front desk use Lucoze?
faqs.a: Yes. The screens are in English, with short plain labels a new receptionist can follow, and onboarding trains your front desk on your own patients. Search by name, UHID, ABHA number or mobile finds the record.

faqs.q: Where is our patient data stored?
faqs.a: In Indian data centres, with backups kept in India — nothing crosses the border. Lucoze is built for DPDP 2023, it's cloud-based (runs on ordinary broadband or mobile data), and you can export all records as CSV/PDF on request with no lock-in.

faqs.q: Do you support clinics in Tripura?
faqs.a: Yes, remote-first. Our team is in Konnagar, West Bengal, so Tripura clinics get video onboarding, data-migration help, and WhatsApp and in-app chat support rather than an in-person visit to every clinic. For larger hospital or nursing-home deployments we can arrange on-site setup, and there's a 14-day trial to start.
